Senior Living Owners (SL-Awareness): LinkedIn Ads

Eight awareness ads for senior living owners who don't know Boldt, on light gray with a white test version of each. Ready for manager review.

Manager review 0 approved0 need changes0 not reviewed0 removed Background

Editing is on for every ad. Click any text on an ad, its intro text or its LinkedIn headline to change it. Changes save in this browser as you type. Click Done editing to enlarge ads again.

How this file is organized

Every ad says, in plain words, that Boldt buys senior living communities and brings in an experienced operator. Messages come from Heidi's Off-Market Senior Living Strategy deck and the NIC Conference Brochure. LI-04B tests the word "Monetize" against LI-04, and LI-R1 is for retargeting only.

  1. Type your name in the review bar.
  2. Each ad appears twice: on the campaign's light gray background, then on white. Remove the set you don't want, or approve both to run the background test.
  3. Click Approve or Needs changes under each ad, and add notes if needed.
  4. To change wording, click Edit text under an ad, then click its headline, support line, intro text or LinkedIn headline. Edit all text in the review bar turns editing on for every ad.
  5. Click Remove ad twice to delete an ad from the file.
  6. Everything saves automatically for everyone who opens this page in the dashboard. Download review summary gives a spreadsheet of every decision.

The 1200x628 versions, Google display ads, video, guide and landing page are on the Campaigns tab.

Hover over any ad to see it larger. Click to keep it open, and press Esc to close.

Boldt Real EstatePromoted

You have spent years building a successful senior living community. Whether you are thinking about retirement, passing it on or stepping back from the day-to-day, the next step matters.
